primary_title: Internalization of the m2 muscarinic acetylcholine receptor. Arrestin-independent and -dependent pathways
decision_basis: Primary mutant/binding assays support the CHRM2 ICL3 TVSTS 307-311 cluster as a phosphorylation-dependent arrestin-1 binding and desensitization determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ARRB1 historical arrestin-2 mapping, cluster-level semantics, arrestin-independent basal internalization, human HEK-tsA201 context, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Distinct phosphorylation sites in SST2A somatostatin receptor determine beta-arrestin binding and receptor internalization
decision_basis: Primary Thr-site mutant assays support the SSTR2 T353/T354-containing threonine cluster as a beta-arrestin-1 association/internalization determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve rat sst2A, review-supported ARRB1 isoform mapping, cluster-level and nonexclusive site semantics, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Role of the C terminus in neuropeptide Y Y1 receptor desensitization and internalization
decision_basis: Y1R truncation and beta-arrestin2-GFP assays support the Ser352-to-Ser360 C-terminal regulatory region as a bounded beta-arrestin-2 recruitment/desensitization determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve region-level rather than single-site semantics, rat Y1R, NPY and beta-arrestin2-GFP context, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Beta-arrestin 2-mediated internalization of the dopamine D1 receptor is regulated by phosphorylation sites in the third intracellular loop
decision_basis: Modern mutant/translocation assays support the DRD1 ICL3 S256/S258/S259 site-set as a beta-arrestin-2 internalization/translocation determinant, with earlier review-cited phosphorylation evidence.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ICL3 support semantics, rat D1R, dopamine, C-terminal-site distinction, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.
